messages.subject: Question Scaling factors, delta parameterization
parts:
Dear lavaan group,

I try to estimate a latent growth curve model with delta parameterization for binary data in R with similiar results to Mplus (possibly small difference because of implemented procedures). I attached the Mplus, R-Code and the data.

The only problem is to estimate the Scaling factors (Syntax: ~*~)  freely in R. I want to restrict the first scaling factor to one and the others to estimate free:


Part of problematic syntax:

R:
diab1 ~*~ diab1
diab2 ~*~ diab2
...
-> How to restrict diab1 to 1 and estimate diab2 - diab6 freely?

Mplus:
{diab1@1}; !scaling parameter set for identification for factor mean;
 {diab2-diab6};

Results:
R:
Scales y*:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)   Std.lv  Std.all
    diab1             1.000                               1.000    1.000
    diab2             1.000                               1.000    1.000
...

Mplus:
 Scales
    DIAB1              1.000      0.000    999.000    999.000
    DIAB2              1.080      0.029     36.888      0.000
...


The example is part of the following book (page 186):
Newsom, J. T. (2015). Longitudinal structural equation modeling: A comprehensive introduction. Routledge.


Thanks in advance!
Julius

On Wednesday, January 17, 2018 at 10:35:47 AM UTC+1, Yves Rosseel wrote:
> *Part of problematic syntax: *
>
> R:
> diab1 ~*~ diab1
> diab2 ~*~ diab2
> ...
> -> How to restrict diab1 to 1 and estimate diab2 - diab6 freely?

You need to write:

diab1 ~*~ 1*diab1
diab2 ~*~ diab2
...

Yves.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Question Scaling factors, delta parameterization

I have already tried it out

Scaling factors:
diab1 ~*~ 1*diab1
diab2 ~*~ diab2
diab3 ~*~ diab3
diab4 ~*~ diab4
diab5 ~*~ diab5
diab6 ~*~ diab6

Result:
Scales y*:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)   Std.lv  Std.all
    diab1             1.000                               1.000    1.000
    diab2             1.000                               1.000    1.000
 ....
-> still not freely estimated

To freely estimate it, don't tell lavaan the value (1*), tell it the value is missing (NA*)

diab1 ~*~ NA*diab1
